method.note: jtop EMC.val is INERT (hard 0) on these JetPacks; the working DDR-bandwidth counter is the BPMP actmon debugfs node.
method.workload: sustained trtexec replay of the canonical GR00T stage engines (st5c on Thor; g{vit,llm,dit} on Orin), --duration=12 --warmUp=2000
method.actmon_unit: raw counter (M tx/s); NOT GB/s. linear at low load, COMPRESSES near saturation.
method.gbps_derivation: DERIVED by interpolating each stage's MEASURED actmon on the per-board MEASURED GPU-d2d bandwidth calibration curve (gpu_d2d_calibration). Reference for %-of-peak is the MEASURED achieved saturation (d2d copy), NOT the datasheet nameplate. Supersedes the 2026-09-24 datasheet-anchor derivation, which a review found circular (it drew the peak line at the DiT bar) and which overstated ViT/LLM.
method.provenance: actmon/gpu_ms/cpu_pct = MEASURED; gpu_d2d_calibration = MEASURED; ddr_gbps = DERIVED; datasheet_peak = SOURCED

census.Thor: clean (desktop only; no model tenant). self-reaped after run.
census.Orin: cleaned before the run: a leftover 14.75 GB numpy test process from earlier work (non-daemon threads, stop flag never set, running 1767 s) was loading the memory bus and inflating the idle floor 47x; it was killed, the idle floor dropped 21.7M->0.05M, then the stages were measured clean.

gpu_d2d_calibration.method: MEASURED GPU device-to-device cudaMemcpy: GB/s = 2*bytes/wall (exact, a pure copy is 1 read + 1 write, no write-allocate ambiguity); duty-cycled to sweep average bandwidth. Sampled simultaneously with BPMP actmon. This maps actmon->GB/s WHERE THE WORKLOAD ACTUALLY SITS (a CPU burn cannot reach the GPU actmon range).
gpu_d2d_calibration.note: actmon is LINEAR in bandwidth at low load then COMPRESSES near saturation (measured: Thor 51M/151 -> 70M/253); GB/s is interpolated on this measured curve, not anchored to the datasheet.
